<h2>Run the sjSDM Cross-Validation Preparation Sequence</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Builds selected cross-validation preparation targets in isolated unit stores
without requesting tuning fits or final models.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>run_sjsdm_cv_preparation_sequence(
  unit_pipeline = NULL,
  preparation_target_names = NULL,
  unit_store_suffixes = NULL,
  prebuild_interpolation = FALSE,
  preparation_resource_profile = "shared",
  interpolation_workers_override = NULL,
  run_pipeline_function = run_pipeline,
  target_store = load_active_config_value("target_store"),
  resolve_store_function = resolve_pipeline_store_path,
  load_metadata_function = load_targets_store_metadata,
  classify_error_function = classify_sjsdm_unit_pipeline_error,
  diagnose_endpoints_function = diagnose_sjsdm_cv_preparation_endpoints,
  read_target_function = targets::tar_read_raw,
  invalidate_target_function = targets::tar_invalidate,
  validate_endpoints = base::identical(run_pipeline_function, run_pipeline),
  cache_recovery_attempts = 8L
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="unit_pipeline">unit_pipeline</code></td>
<td>
<p>Character scalar path to the production unit pipeline.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="preparation_target_names">preparation_target_names</code></td>
<td>
<p>Non-empty character vector of prepared-fold target names.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="unit_store_suffixes">unit_store_suffixes</code></td>
<td>
<p>Optional character vector of spatial-unit store suffixes. 'NULL' runs the
non-nested store used by a temporal profile.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="prebuild_interpolation">prebuild_interpolation</code></td>
<td>
<p>Logical forwarded to [run_pipeline()] for each unit execution.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="preparation_resource_profile">preparation_resource_profile</code></td>
<td>
<p>Runtime resource profile forwarded to [run_pipeline()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="interpolation_workers_override">interpolation_workers_override</code></td>
<td>
<p>Optional explicit positive interpolation worker count.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="run_pipeline_function">run_pipeline_function</code></td>
<td>
<p>Injectable pipeline runner. Defaults to [run_pipeline()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="target_store">target_store</code></td>
<td>
<p>Root target-store path used to inspect unit-level target errors.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="resolve_store_function">resolve_store_function</code></td>
<td>
<p>Injectable unit-store path resolver.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="load_metadata_function">load_metadata_function</code>, <code id="classify_error_function">classify_error_function</code></td>
<td>
<p>Injectable target-metadata loader and unit-error classifier.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="diagnose_endpoints_function">diagnose_endpoints_function</code></td>
<td>
<p>Injectable prepared-endpoint diagnostic.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="read_target_function">read_target_function</code></td>
<td>
<p>Injectable raw target reader used by endpoint validation.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="invalidate_target_function">invalidate_target_function</code></td>
<td>
<p>Injectable target invalidator used for legacy-cache recovery.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="validate_endpoints">validate_endpoints</code></td>
<td>
<p>Logical. If 'TRUE', require every requested endpoint to have successful,
hashed metadata and to be readable. Defaults to 'TRUE' for the production
pipeline runner and 'FALSE' for injected test runners.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="cache_recovery_attempts">cache_recovery_attempts</code></td>
<td>
<p>Non-negative integer maximum number of targeted legacy-cache retries.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Details</h3>

<p>This function is used only when a main-analysis runner is explicitly placed
in CV-fold preparation mode. A target-level failure in one spatial unit or
temporal store is recorded so all remaining independent work can be
attempted. Expected infeasibility is accepted. Unexplained target failures
and per-unit runner failures without fresh target metadata are reported
after all spatial units have been attempted. This guarantees maximum unit
coverage while keeping unexpected outcomes visible at component exit.
Legacy-cache recovery follows all affected targets and dependencies visible
in metadata, but stops for registered data limitations or when an
invalidation makes no progress. Final unexplained-error output is grouped
once per unit.
</p>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>Invisibly, a unit-status tibble. Prepared targets remain cached in
production stores.
</p>
